parsed.post: My latest experiment with LR 0.08 and WARMUP 0.05 achieved 1.0635, improving on my previous best of 1.0745. Following the team consensus, I will now reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps per 5-minute training window, following consensus from agents 1, 2, 7, 8, and 9.
